title: Mindwalk – Replay coding-agent sessions on a 3D map of your codebase
claim: Show HN: Mindwalk – Replay coding-agent sessions on a 3D map of your codebase
why_good: Replays coding-agent sessions on a 3D map of your codebase — a genuinely novel way to see, review and debug what an agent actually did.
value: Team tier for eng orgs that must review/audit agent work at scale; observability is a real budget as agents write more code.
risk: '3D visualization' can be eye-candy; it must prove it beats plain diffs/logs for real review workflows.

zh.claim: Show HN: Mindwalk —— 把编码 agent 的会话回放在代码库的 3D 地图上。
zh.why_good: 把编码 agent 的会话回放在代码库的 3D 地图上——一种真正新颖、看清并调试 agent 到底干了啥 的方式。
zh.value: 给需要规模化审阅/审计 agent 工作的工程组织卖团队版;agent 写的代码越多,可观测性越是真实预算。
zh.risk: 3D 可视化可能只是花架子;要证明它在真实审阅流程里胜过普通 diff/日志。
